question: What is the percentage difference in total gas consumption between CZK-paying and EUR-paying customers in the year with the highest EUR consumption?

WITH target_year AS (
    SELECT SUBSTRING(T2."XCL_020", 1, 4) AS year_str
    FROM customers AS T1
    INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1."XCL_001" = T2."XCL_019"
    WHERE T1."XCL_003" = 'EUR'
    GROUP BY SUBSTRING(T2."XCL_020", 1, 4)
    ORDER BY SUM(T2."XCL_021") DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(CASE WHEN T1."XCL_003" = 'CZK' THEN T2."XCL_021" ELSE 0 END) AS czk_total,
        SUM(CASE WHEN T1."XCL_003" = 'EUR' THEN T2."XCL_021" ELSE 0 END) AS eur_total
    FROM customers AS T1
    INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1."XCL_001" = T2."XCL_019"
    WHERE SUBSTRING(T2."XCL_020", 1, 4) = (SELECT year_str FROM target_year)
)
SELECT 
    CAST((czk_total - eur_total) AS REAL) * 100 / eur_total 
FROM consumption

WITH eur_by_year AS (
    SELECT
        strftime('%Y', t.XCL_011) AS yr,
        SUM(t.XCL_018) AS total_eur

    JOIN customers c ON t.XCL_013 = c.XCL_001

    GROUP BY yr

    SELECT yr
    FROM eur_by_year
    ORDER BY total_eur DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
totals AS (
    SELECT
        c.XCL_003 AS currency,
        SUM(t.XCL_018) AS total_gas
    FROM transactions_1k t
    JOIN customers c ON t.XCL_013 = c.XCL_001
    WHERE strftime('%Y', t.XCL_011) = (SELECT yr FROM top_year)

    GROUP BY c.XCL_003
)
SELECT
    ABS(MAX(CASE WHEN currency = 'CZK' THEN total_gas END) -
        MAX(CASE WHEN currency = 'EUR' THEN total_gas END)) * 100.0 /
    MAX(CASE WHEN currency = 'EUR' THEN total_gas END) AS percentage_difference
FROM totals
